dialogues.speaker: Callum
dialogues.text: Sister Philomena... I—I'm setting sail next week. Mr. Matthaus has hired us for his liquor trade up north in Snezhnaya...

dialogues.speaker: Callum
dialogues.text: But I'm really scared. I've never been a sailor before, and this is my first voyage... what if...

dialogues.speaker: Philomena
dialogues.text: It'll be alright. Even if it weren't your first time at sea, the ocean is never truly safe.

dialogues.speaker: Philomena
dialogues.text: If you do set out to sea, I'll pray to the Anemo Archon for your journey. Don't worry, I've prayed for many sailors before...

dialogues.speaker: Callum
dialogues.text: Oh, thank you so much! So... all those sailors returned safely, right?
